summary: Reconciled four independent TypeScript/Zod definitions that all declared the schema identity literal 'atlas.workflow-action.v1' with materially different field shapes. Extended packages/parent-atlas/src/core/workflow-action-event.ts's workflowActionEventSchema into a lossless superset (the canonical owner), added a cross-workspace package export subpath, and added bidirectional adapter functions in each of the three sveltekit-frontend definitions. Zero production callers of any of the four original shapes existed before this change, so this was a zero-live-migration-risk convergence.

realBugFoundAndFixed.description: ledgerState()'s switch statement over WorkflowActionEventV1['kind'] became non-exhaustive once the canonical kind enum was widened -- TypeScript correctly flagged 'Function lacks ending return statement'. This falsifies design.md's original claim that extending the kind enum would be purely non-breaking for every existing file; it was non-breaking for schema validation but NOT for exhaustive-switch consumers. Fixed by mapping the 4 new kinds to the existing PROGRESS ledger state.
